title: Pointwise criterion for a composed restriction
statement: Let $\rho_1,\rho_2,\sigma$ be restrictions on $n$ variables, and let $\rho_1 \ast \rho_2$ denote the composition of $\rho_1$ and $\rho_2$, whose value at a coordinate $i$ is the value fixed by $\rho_1$ at $i$ if $\rho_1$ fixes it and otherwise the value $\rho_2$ assigns at $i$. Then $\rho_1 \ast \rho_2 = \sigma$ if and only if, for every coordinate $i \in \mathrm{Fin}\,n$, the value of $\rho_1 \ast \rho_2$ at $i$ equals $\sigma(i)$.
hypotheses_covered: composition given coordinatewise by the falling-back rule
